$comment: Cargo features that compile test-only code: fixture hooks, fault seams,
oracles and harnesses. No release binary may be built with one of them,
nor with a dependency feature they forward (`dep/feature`, `dep?/feature`).
scripts/generate-bazel-rust-builds.mjs strips them from every production
Bazel rust_library and rust_binary (tests keep them through the generated
fails when one of them reaches a release binary's Bazel graph.
external_crate_features lists test-only features of external crates that
crate_universe enables because a workspace dev-dependency does (it resolves
one feature set per crate across every dependency kind). The
rules_rust patch reads this file and moves each one into a select on
//tools/bazel:release_build in the crate's rendered BUILD file, so editing
scripts/check-bazel-release-features.py fails when a listed feature stays
enabled in a release build of any rendered repository of that crate.
